shadows.label: 阴影 1 - Shadow 1
shadows.description: Shadow Black (`rgba(60,64,67,0.15)`): Standard Material Level 1 elevation (slightly warm gray).

shadows.label: 阴影 2 - Shadow 2
shadows.description: Shadow: `rgba(60,64,67,0.15) 0 4px 8px` plus `rgba(60,64,67,0.30) 0 1px 2px` — Material Level 6 dual shadow

shadows.label: 阴影 3 - Shadow 3
shadows.description: Shadow: `rgba(60,64,67,0.15) 0 4px 8px` plus `rgba(60,64,67,0.30) 0 1px 2px` — Material Level 6 dual shadow

shadows.label: 阴影 4 - Shadow 4
shadows.description: Shadow Philosophy: Google Calendar uses Material Design's dual-shadow elevation system — a sharp 1pt offset for ambient definition + a softer 3pt blur for depth. The shadows are slightly warm (`rgba(60,64,67,...)`), not pure black, which is a Google detail. The FAB sits at Material Level 6 — the highest meaningful elevation in the app — and lifts further when pressed.

shadows.label: 阴影 5 - Shadow 5
shadows.description: Pressed: lifts to `rgba(60,64,67,0.30) 0 6px 12px`, scale stays 1.0 (Material doesn't scale on press)

borders.label: 边框 1 - Border 1
borders.description: Divider (`#DADCE0`): Hairline borders, 30-min gridlines in Day/Week view, calendar list divisions.

borders.label: 边框 2 - Border 2
borders.description: Dark Surface 2 (`#3C4043`): Pressed states, selected rows.

panels.title: 以产品流程为中心

panels.title: 颜色与字体可复用
panels.body: 页面从本地 metadata 与 Design.md 提取 palette、typography 和标签，用于快速预览主题质感。

panels.title: 面向真实界面片段
panels.body: 按钮、输入、卡片和间距样例保持克制，便于比较不同主题的系统性差异。

do: 建议：Use Google Blue {#1A73E8} for the FAB, primary CTAs, links, and the Today highlight。
建议：Use the four Material event colors for system events: Blue meetings, Red declined, Yellow tasks, Green goals。
建议：Honor the 24-color user-selectable calendar palette — let user-named calendars choose their tint。
建议：Use Google Sans Display for nav titles and day numbers; SF Pro Text for body and rows on iOS。
建议：Use TABULAR FIGURES on every time and date — "9:00 AM / 10:30 AM" must align。
dont: 避免：use pure black {#000000} for text — {#202124} is Google's near-black。
避免：bold-weight nav titles or section headers — Google Calendar uses Medium (500), almost never Bold。
避免：apply event colors at full saturation in Day/Week tinted blocks — use 20% saturation for the fill, full saturation for the title text and 3pt left bar。
避免：replace the Material dual-shadow with a single drop-shadow — the dual-shadow IS the Material look。
避免：put the FAB anywhere other than bottom-right。
